positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
- Support Facebook as a backend Hack developer.
- Collaborate with various client teams to scope and implement infra/ internal framework improvements.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Delivered multiple integrations with third-party vendors, enabling customers to pull third-party data into the platform. Wrote Go applications, shipped them to production, and collaborated with teams including UI/UX, legal, and tech writing.
- Authored a Go microservice so users can perform actions on accounts flagged in suspicious activity. Continue to maintain ownership of this service and add features.
- Wrote a data ingestion microservice. Created and integrated with a NoSQL database index and a Redis cache, and wrote monitoring tools to be alerted of usage and error rates. 
- Wrote Go and Python scripts to summarize metrics and provide proof-of-concepts.
positions.insights: Back-End Web Development, Software Development and +3 skills

positions.description:
- Added and updated endpoints on Scala and Go microservices.
- Worked with NoSQL and key-value store databases.
- Conducted end-to-end testing, wrote tests and deployed to multi-cloud production environments.
